text:
maria: Quick intake — Product wants mariner-11b-chat onboarded for conversational assistant. Need perf/quant triage + quality check. Can we run prioritized sweep this week?

josh: +1. Priorities: 1) baseline fp16 single-GPU latency (ctx 512/2048/4096). 2) int8 kernel check. 3) int4 smoke for quality. 4) batching/throughput w/continuous batching.

olivia: I can own the baseline/quant runs. Will start with 512/2048. What's our latency SLO for chat?

kevin: Target p95 < 250ms for 512, < 800ms for 2048, degraded ok beyond that. Throughput p50 for batch 8 should be >= X tokens/sec (TBD). Also need NVTX traces for any tail spikes.

maria: Product target is interactive desktop chat — soft SLO p95 300ms for 512. We'll mark 2048 as acceptable up to 900ms. OK to proceed.

perf-bot: Scheduled perf job #perf-773 for mariner-11b-chat on gpu-a100-80gb, run id 2026-03-19-09:12

olivia: Ran fp16 microbench.

olivia: ```
command: ./bench_runner --model mariner-11b-chat --dtype fp16 --ctx 512 --batch 1
results: p50 84ms, p95 160ms, tokens/s 950
``` 

josh: Good baseline. Next run int8 QAT/llm.int8.

olivia: int8 single-GPU run:

olivia: ```
command: ./bench_runner --model mariner-11b-chat --dtype int8 --ctx 512 --batch 1
results: p50 96ms, p95 220ms, tokens/s 820
notes: slight decoding jitter; KV cache ok
```

noah: Is model stable with prefixed caching? Need prefix cache smoke with ~30 tokens warmup.

olivia: Prefix cache smoke: p95 increased ~18ms; looks within range. Will add NVTX trace.

olivia: int4 smoke (quant-toolchain v0.9) quick run:

olivia: ```
command: ./quant_smoke --model mariner-11b-chat --scheme awq --bits 4 --ctx 512
results: p50 135ms, p95 420ms
quality: short prompt completions look acceptable but present token corruption on rare seeds
```

josh: Flagging int4 quality regression — assign to evals for prompt-suite 1. If >2% regression, mark as blocked for int4 serving.

maria: Action items: olivia run int8 full ctx sweep (512/2048/4096) + batching (1/4/8/16). noah set up evals against conversation-suite and regression alerts. kevin add NVTX traces and error budget check.

kevin: On batching, remember continuous batching default window 10ms — test 0/10/30ms to see tail latency.

olivia: Will post raw numbers in thread when done. Starting int8 2048 run now.

perf-bot: perf job #perf-774 started (int8, ctx 2048, batch 1)

maria: Thanks — if int8 passes quality and perf, we can onboard to staging as dedicated model variant (int8-std). Otherwise stick to fp16.

josh: Also add cold-start/warmup probe: 100 requests after idle and measure first->steady latency ratio.

olivia: Noted. ETA for all runs ~24h. I'll update thread with condensed table.

noah: I'll wire the evals and set a regression threshold at 1.5% per prompt-suite. If breached, we auto-open a rollback ticket.

maria: Great. Sync tomorrow 11am to review results. :thumbsup:
